# System 0/1/2/3 Reading Guide

Unofficial companion to arXiv:2503.06138v3, 16 July 2025. Theory and research agenda, not empirical validation or an implementation.

Research authors: Tadahiro Taniguchi; Yasushi Hirai; Masahiro Suzuki; Shingo Murata; Takato Horii; Kazutoshi Tanaka. Maintainer: 0xHayd3n, with AI assistance; unaffiliated.

- [Versioned primary source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.06138v3)

Always cite section and one-based PDF page. Separate proposal, formalization, philosophical interpretation, reviewed prior evidence, future prediction, and companion analysis. Keep all six authors and the v3 pin. Do not infer universal time cutoffs, proven collective consciousness, convergence for arbitrary societies, or new experimental results. Equation 4 is visibly incomplete; read the formalism cautions before deriving or coding.
